test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table. Only three people sit between J and L when counted from the left of J. Only three people sit between K and C when counted from the right of C. D sits to the immediate right of K. A is an immediate neighbour of C as well as L. Who sits second to the left of B?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, J, K and L are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre of the table.

1) Only three people sit between J and L when counted from the left of J.

2) Only three people sit between K and C when counted from the right of C.

3) D sits to the immediate right of K.

4) A is an immediate neighbour of C as well as L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b97c978e4ea86baef9252e0ec2c6b8dba69637ab98eb25e567406b046a2c28.png] 

Here,** A** sits second to the left of B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
